headline: This change records every customer request in full, creating a serious privacy and security risk.
what_changed: The app now records details for every visit and form submission.
The records include each visitor’s extra request information and the full text they submitted.
The records also include whether the app accepted or rejected each request and how long it took.

risks.title: Customer details enter logs
risks.explanation: Every submitted form is copied into the app’s records. For a lending product, this can include applicants’ contact, financial, and other sensitive details. Anyone with access to these records could see that data, and keeping it there increases the damage from an account breach. Remove or mask personal details before recording requests.

risks.title: Login secrets enter logs
risks.explanation: The change copies all extra request information into the records. That can include login proof, browser session identifiers, or other access secrets sent by customers. A person who can read the records could use such secrets to access customer accounts while they remain valid. Never record these values; remove sensitive entries before logging.

good_news: The change is small and can be made safe by recording only the request type, web address, result, and timing.
